svg.title: R0.73H exact q=2 subcertificate and finite harmonic-feedback diagnostics

cc:Work.dc:title: R0.73H exact q=2 subcertificate and finite harmonic-feedback diagnostics
cc:Work.dc:description: The exact q=2 energy subcertificate closes its stated coercivity arithmetic, while the finite binary64 hierarchy shows the preregistered response scaling, a negative projected cubic coefficient on the frozen grid, and numerical checks below their gates; none is a continuum saturation result.
